notes.title: 0.6.4 Update
notes.content:
[h2]New Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*]New world map node "Treasure"
[*]9 new enemy units
[*]12 new battle maps (including elite battles)
[*]Gear upgrade system
[*]5 new gears(1 common, 3 uncommon, 1 rare)
[*]2 new boss artifacts
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]ICBM & Judgment ability initial cooltime is set to 90% of the full cooltime
[*]Gear ability level up does not reset the ability cooltime
[*]Modified elite battles to be placed at random nodes on the world map
[*]Several battle difficulty level adjusted
[*]Hero level up system changed: earns EXP after all battles & cannot level up at the resting node.
[*]"Ziggy" HP -20%
[*]"Great White Sharkoid" HP +20%
[*]"Coovoodoo" (previously Colonel Turt) HP & defense highly increased, movement speed decreased
[*]"Hellhound" HP highly increased
[*]"Zombie" HP decreased
[*]"Flower Sisters" HP increased
[*]"Foxo" undercover set to be able to be stopped by a nearby minion
[*]Basic attack with DOT now prioritize targets without DOT
[*]Changed the default battle background music
[*]Artifact "Life Pill" changed to shop artifact
[*]Artifact "Pure Mind" critical chance accumulation decreased
[*]Artifact "Executioner's Saw Blade" total amount of DOT decreased
[*]Artifact "Hourglass" upgraded
[*]Artifact "Lightning Rod" additional damage increased
[*]Artifact "Rubber Hammer" effect changed to status effect duration +100%
[*]Gear "Firecracker" ability cooltime speed up effect downgraded at all level
[*]Gear "Seven Branches" attack speed downgraded
[*]Gear "Auto Repeater" damage decreased
[*]"Anti-personnel Mine" ability of gear "Fierce Crusher" damage highly increased
[*]Gear "Red Bomb" damage range compressed & critical chance increased
[*]Gear "Dragon Sword" physical & magic damage increased
[*]Gear "Mace" stun chance increased at all levels
[*]"Curare" ability of gear "Blowpipe" damage highly increased
[*]Some of event rewards changed
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*]Right-click or ESC key during battle now cancel the current selected state
[*]World map scroll direction reversed
[*]Tooltips added to the barracks positioning button
[*]Option added to mute the application when it is in the background
[*]Tips added at first encounter of flying enemy
[*]Color of the ally and enemy HP bar differentiated
[*]"Ziggy" now show state phrase when it is unstoppable
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Pop-up order twisting problem when stopping at certain point fixed
[*]Screen obscuration when acquring gems reward from the bunny goddess fixed
[*]"Cat'O Wisp" ability of "QuadTigerSlayer" bouncing to the enemy too far away issue fixed
[/list]

[h2]Work in Progress[/h2]
[list]
[*]New boss
[*]New hero
[*]Equipment unlock system based on hero proficiency
[*]New gears and artifacts
[/list]

[b]Warning : your current run will be deleted after update[/b]

notes.title: 0.6.1 Update
notes.content:
[h2]New Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*]New boss "Ziggy"
[*]3 new achievements
[*]Added goddess NPC who gives benefits at the game start (disabled when tutorial option is checked)
[*]GIves 10 gems when leveling up the hero after reaching the max hero level
[*]Event options added and polished
[*]9 new gear abilities (archer and barrracks)
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Decreased multi-attack tower's critical damage (100% -> 25%, 50%)
[*]Decreased most of magic gear damage(-10%)
[*]Increased most of archer gear damage(+10%)
[*]Decreased drum artillery gear damage a bit
[*]Improved statistics data for further update
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a feature to read gear information at gear draft, shop and inventory
[*]Show tooltip on artifact reward
[*]Added toggle option to automatically select a next gear during battle
[*]Can read enemy info again at the bottom panel if the enemy info exixts
[*]Show gear grade color at inventory during battle 
[*]Deselect enemy or minion unit when it is dead
[*]Show ally icon at bottom panel if an ally is selected
[*]Event performance and interaction improved
[*]Support 21:9, 16:10 resolutions
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed shark dive effect
[*]Fixed white horn bow's minion attack stat
[*]Artillery tower's projectile can affect to flying target
[*]Fixed boss not to be affected by freezing or begolding abiilties
[*]Removed enemy ability effect which stop tower when the battle is over
[*]Fixed Mugi ability which hit the enemy, not allies
[/list]

[h2]Work in Progress[/h2]
[list]
[*]New boss
[*]New enemies and battles
[*]New gears and artifacts
[*]Gear reinforcement
[*]Improved worldmap progress system
[/list]

notes.title: 2023 ROADMAP
notes.content:
Hello!

It's been a week since Natti's release, and we're going to share the 2023 roadmap of "Natti".
We're preparing a lot of contents and QoL, so please look forward to it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43510148/097d9f1a1e350c2d9d7a98105428cfa48efffc3b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Key Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Heroes: There will be more heroes ready to back up Boozer, who is struggling alone. Each hero uses different spell and abilities.
[*]New Bosses and Enemies: The enemies threatening the Natti are not all we see now. New bosses and dozens of enemies will be added.
[*]Upgrade system: You will be able to strengthen the gear obtained during the play so it can be a stronger and more characteristic property.
[*]Hard mode: Every time you clear a game, a higher level of difficulty will be unlocked. Challenging the highest level of difficulty requires very high proficiency.
[*]Content unlocks: After each run, new contents will be unlocked according to the progress. Get new gears and artifacts and enjoy something different than before.
[*]Encyclopedia: You can read the information of enemy, gears and artifacts acquired during the game.
[*]Infinity mode: After you clear all the games, you can enjoy endless battles with your enemies who will be hard to challenge. Let's compete to see how long you can hold them.
[/list]

[h2]Currently in progress[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43510148/c077a087fa0bb9a13185fa1b09d0c0bc3bc2da8c.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New Boss: A terrifying boss related to fire🔥 is being prepared.
[*]Equipment description: We are making a UI that can explain the features of the gears in more detail.
[*]Other QoL improvements: We are improving on the insufficient convenience based on the reported feedback.
[/list]
